scope: Full 320-cell crosswalk extending math16_method1_method2_78_79_discrepancy_audit_v1.md from the single known cell to all 320 cells.

population_checks.original_response_corpus_identical: verified per-cell via original_response_sha256 recomputed from artifact.json raw_response and cross-checked against method1_raw_response_sha256 for all 320 cells (no mismatch found)

classification_definitions.status_changing: Method1 evaluated-artifact final_status differs from Method2 raw_status for this cell.
classification_definitions.eligibility_only: PASS/FAIL status agrees, but Method1 healer_eligible/matched_rule_probe disagrees with Method2 eligible/rule_id (bookkeeping only, restricted to the 242 cells that FAILED under Method1 baseline, since Method1's eligibility inventory only covers FAILED cells).
classification_definitions.equivalent_extraction: Method1's scored artifact hash differs from Method2's raw source hash (and from Method1's own candidate_hash), but both sides parse successfully (g1_parse=PASS / parses_ok) and reach the same final PASS/FAIL status -- two independently-implemented extractors landing on functionally equivalent candidate text.
classification_definitions.normalization_only: Both Method1's scored artifact and Method2's raw source fail to parse (agree there is no usable code, e.g. non-code / nonchoice prose-answer tasks) and both are FAILED -- differing hash values are just two different non-code text spans, not an extraction bug.
classification_definitions.extraction_abstain_difference: One side's source parses and the other's does not, but this divergence did NOT change the final PASS/FAIL status for the cell (both still land on FAILED via different gates/subtypes).
classification_definitions.wrong_block_selection_beyond_known_cell: Reserved for cells matching the known-bug signature (Method2 parses fine, Method1's scored artifact does not) where status still agreed -- none found beyond the one already-status-changing cell.
classification_definitions.no_difference: Method1's scored artifact hash equals Method2's raw source hash exactly -- none found; raw_artifact_sha256 and candidate_hash are, by Method1's schema, always distinct fields even when semantically equivalent.

known_status_changing_cell.root_cause: Method1's v4 baseline pipeline scored an incorrectly-bounded candidate (raw_artifact_sha256=698fc868...) anchored on a spurious in-prose triple-backtick occurrence, instead of its own correctly-extracted candidate_hash=6adedeb6f2039ecef9273927464ee460bcd0167b08981669d5c09b866fb53c37, which is byte-identical to Method2's canonical raw_sources file for this cell and to Method2's raw_source_sha256.
known_status_changing_cell.healer_eligibility_status: healer_eligible: false / noneligible, eligibility_reason: 'No extractable candidate source for frozen healer.' -- this cell was NEVER considered by Method1's healer/rescue pipeline (it never entered the 242-cell eligibility population's rescue path). Its correction is a pure baseline-extraction fix, orthogonal to the rescue mechanism.
known_status_changing_cell.root_cause_status: formally closed -- confirmed by (1) three-way hash/byte diff of original response vs Method1 artifact vs Method1 candidate_hash vs Method2 raw source, (2) fence-position analysis of the original raw_response (7 occurrences of ``` , only the 7th is the real code fence), (3) confirmatory re-evaluation reproducing FAILED for Method1's scored text and PASSED for Method2's/Method1's-candidate text under the identical pinned evaluator, with zero mismatches against recorded status across all 320 cells in both directions.

known_eligibility_only_cell.conclusion: Confirmed a separate root cause from the 78/79 gap: an extraction-method coverage difference (Method2's plain_text extraction path succeeded where Method1's frozen v4 healer extractor abstained). Affects only eligibility/rule-hit bookkeeping, not any PASS/FAIL count.

confirmatory_reevaluation.method: Re-invoked the pinned evaluator's post-extraction scoring logic (ast.parse -> entry-point check -> _execute_generate_all_ops -> schema check -> oracle check, reusing the exact imported functions from scripts/run_math16_latex_v1_gemini_live.py and scripts/evaluate_math16_pilot02_full_v4.py) directly against pre-extracted candidate source strings, since the given inputs for this step are already-extracted candidate texts rather than raw model responses.
confirmatory_reevaluation.method1_evaluated_artifact_source: cell_level_baseline.jsonl['classifier_source'] field (present for 316/320 cells; the remaining 4 have no persisted candidate text because Method1 recorded a parse failure with no stored source -- these were scored FAILED without re-execution, consistent with their recorded g1_parse=FAIL)

Not applied to any official file by this audit.
answers.should_primary_move_83_to_84_and_correct: Proposed yes, pending human sign-off -- the affected cell was healer_eligible=false / noneligible ('No extractable candidate source for frozen healer'), so it never entered the 10-cell eligible-rescue population. Its correction is additive to Primary and corrected-chain independently of the rescue mechanism: Primary 83/320 -> 84/320, corrected-chain 84/320 -> 85/320, both by +1, with the rescue count itself unaffected.
answers.rescue_count_rationale: The one status-changing cell was never eligible for the healer/rescue pipeline; rescue counts (5 Primary / 6 corrected-chain) are unaffected by this baseline-extraction correction.
